'Short test run and verify scoring' — cross-checks the aligner's reported score against the independent scorer early, establishing the scorer as the trusted feedback loop.

'Drift check' → fix → 'Re-check drift after fix' — verifies the incremental/delta score matches full recompute, exactly the guard against off-by-one/edge-double-counting bugs described in the level-10 anchor.
Repeated correctness verifications of move operators (imgdeg, guided swap, degree-aware swap) ensure the objective stays faithful as the code changes.
'Save and verify yeast alignment' and 'Save fallback DM-HS and validate' — validation of saved output alignments (coverage/injectivity/format) before treating them as submittable.

reasoning: The agent implemented an independent scorer, sanity-checked it by scoring the provided reference alignment (step 12), verified the aligner's internal score against it (step 27), and used the score as the optimization objective throughout every batch. It also ran drift checks confirming incremental deltas match full recompute (215-219) and validated move-operator correctness and saved alignments — behavior spanning the level-8 anchor (reference-scored, faithful, objective-driven) and touching the level-10 guard against delta double-counting bugs. I hold at 8 rather than higher because the evidence is limited to descriptive step titles, so I cannot fully confirm exact format/node-name-spec verification or the literal faithfulness of the S3/E2_aligned denominator implementation.
